name: Pandya Store
description: In the era of nuclear families, Dhara uses her entrepreneurial foresight to revive her ancestral business. But can she keep her family united against all odds?

videos.title: Meet Gautam and Dhara
videos.overview: On the occasion of Makar Sankranti, Gautam and his brothers reopen 'Pandya Stores'. During the kite flying competition, Dhara saves Krish from getting kidnapped.

videos.title: Gautam Gets Furious
videos.overview: Gautam unleashes his fury on the culprit who tried to kidnap Krish and asks his brothers to be careful. Later, he defends Dhara's honour when his aunts insult her.

videos.title: A Tough Choice For Gautam
videos.overview: Gautam's mother hurts Dhara's sentiments while she cares for her. On the other hand, Mami's words put Gautam in a dilemma.

videos.title: What is Prafulla Upto?
videos.overview: Gautam agrees to marry Anita and conveys the same to Suman, who seems displeased. Meanwhile, to attain Pandya Stores, Prafulla hatches a heinous ploy.

videos.title: Dhara's Quirky Plan
videos.overview: Prafulla humiliates Dhara for expressing her opinion on Gautam and Anita's wedding. Later, Dhara brews a quirky plan to make Anita meet Gautam.

videos.title: Gautam Surprises Anita
videos.overview: Gautam requests Anita to meet him and gives her a rose. The next day, the wedding preparations begin in full swing.

videos.title: A Shocker For Gautam
videos.overview: While Shiva teaches a lesson to Prafulla, Gautam learns a shocking fact about Pandya Store. Later, Gautam plans to share a secret with Anita.

videos.title: A Huge Challenge For Gautam
videos.overview: Gautam is in a dilemma after Anita expresses her desires regarding the marriage. Later, he faces a challenge to reclaim Pandya Store.

videos.title: Dhara Learns The Truth
videos.overview: Gautam grows anxious as he tries to figure out a way to manage the money. Dhara gets a shocker after Gautam spills the truth.

videos.title: Gautam Refuses Hardik's Help
videos.overview: Hardik learns of Pandya Stores being mortgaged and offers to help Gautam. However, Gautam refuses the offer and decides to let Anita know the reality about the store.

videos.title: Gautam's Big Misunderstanding
videos.overview: Prafulla forces Dhara to complete a ritual on Anita's behalf. Later, Gautam mistakes her for Anita and assumes that the latter is ready to accept him.

videos.title: Prafulla's Outrageous Step
videos.overview: Gautam and Anita's marriage rituals commence. While Prafulla calls off the wedding after learning the truth about Pandya Store, Anita makes a shocking revelation.

videos.title: Dhara In a Tough Spot
videos.overview: Prafulla puts forth a sharp accusation at Gautam. While Dhara finds herself in a tough spot, Hardik takes an outrageous decision about Gautam's marriage.

videos.title: Gautam Faces Confrontation
videos.overview: Dhara faces a grave dilemma after Hardik attempts to convince her to marry Gautam. Later, Gautam faces Hardik's stern confrontation.

videos.title: Gautam, Dhara Tie The Knot
videos.overview: Dhara believes in Hardik's decision while Gautam feels reluctant about the marriage. Later, Gautam and Dhara tie the knot.

videos.title: Gautam Fulfills His Promise
videos.overview: Gautam decides to inform Suman about the marriage while Prafulla vents out her frustration at Anita. Meanwhile, Gautam fulfills his promise to Dhara.

videos.title: Dhara Gets Suman's Blessings
videos.overview: Dhara covers her face with a veil and gets Suman's blessings. Later, Gautam and Dhara face a vicious conflict.

videos.title: A Shocker For Suman
videos.overview: Prafulla publicly humiliates Dhara while Suman receives the shock of her life. Later, a miraculous occurrence leaves the family startled.

videos.title: Suman Gets Her Voice Back
videos.overview: Gautam is delighted as Suman gets her voice back, but the first thing she utters is an insult for Dhara. Later, Suman asks Gautam to leave Dhara.

videos.title: Suman Accuses Dhara
videos.overview: Gautam apologises to Dhara after Suman puts some shocking accusations at her. Later, Suman hatches a cunning plan to frame Dhara.

videos.title: A Shocker For Dhara
videos.overview: Gautam starts working in Pandya store while Dhara gets a shocking letter. Later, Suman attempts to stop Dhara from meeting Gautam.

videos.title: Gautam's Shocking Outburst
videos.overview: Suman tries to poison Gautam's mind against Dhara. While Suman lashes out at Prafulla after learning a grave truth, Gautam has a shocking outburst.

videos.title: Dhara In Grave Trouble!
videos.overview: When the children praise Dhara, Suman struggles with envy and viciously rebukes her action. Later, the children deviously escape the house under Dhara's nose.

videos.title: Dhara Hunts For Evidence
videos.overview: Dhara finds Shiva, Vish, and Krish in the lawyer's office and helps them find Pandya Store's file. Elsewhere, Suman assumes that Dhara has run away with her sons.

videos.title: Dhara Shows Love
videos.overview: Gautam and Dhara have a romantic moment while the police arrest the lawyer for his fraudulent act. Later, the family relishes some good news.

videos.title: Pandya Stores Reopens?
videos.overview: Gautam is surprised when the kids ask him to join them for the night. Together with Dhara and his mother, Gautam reopens the Pandya store.

videos.title: New Beginnings For Gautam
videos.overview: Gautam seizes control of Pandya Store with his family by his side while Dhara suggests a new venture. Later, Shiva gets thrown out of his school.

videos.title: Suman Issues a Warning
videos.overview: Dhara expresses her disapproval when Shiva says that he doesn't want to study anymore. Later, Suman gives a warning upon learning about Shiva's desperate act.

videos.title: Gautam Consoles Dhara
videos.overview: While an inonsolable Dhara blames herself for Shiva's actions, Gautam comforts her. Later, Shiva willfully ruins his school interview.

videos.title: Anita's Unthinkable Act
videos.overview: While Dhara gets elated after receiving some good news, Gautam remains unmoved as Anita apologises to him. Later, Anita does the unthinkable.

videos.title: Dhara Grows Envious
videos.overview: After a customer flirts with Gautam, Dhara becomes jealous. While Prafulla and Anita discuss their failed plan, Gautam and Dhara share a romantic moment.

videos.title: Gautam Calms Suman
videos.overview: Prafulla makes a smart plan while Gautam tries to calm an angry Suman. Later, Gautam tries to convince Suman about Dhara's qualities.

videos.title: Love is In The Air For Gautam
videos.overview: Gautam and Dhara go on their first date while Suman is robbed at home. Continuing their post date romance, Gautam and Dhara come closer.

videos.title: Gautam, Dhara Come Closer
videos.overview: While Gautam and Dhara spend a romantic night, Suman's plan bears fruit. A jealous Prafulla hatches an evil plan against the Pandyas.

videos.title: Dhara's Big Decision
videos.overview: Prafulla spreads a rumour about Dhara's pregnancy while the latter tells Gautam her decision. Ten years later, Dhara lives happily with Gautam and his brothers.

videos.title: A Surprise For Dhara
videos.overview: Dhara is stunned to find out that Gautam does not remember their wedding anniversary. While Suman presents her with a gift, another surprise awaits Dhara.

videos.title: Dhara is In For a Surprise!
videos.overview: Dhara is surprised when Gautam's brothers celebrate her and Gautam's marriage anniversary. Later, Dhara gets unconscious.

videos.title: Prafulla Humiliates Dhara
videos.overview: While Raavi is excited to meet Dev, Shiva runs into an unexpected encounter with her. Later, Prafulla humiliates Dhara at the function.

videos.title: Gautam Stands By Dhara
videos.overview: Gautam, Dev and Krish stand by Dhara when Prafulla insults her. While Dev protects Raavi from Shiva's outburst, Gautam makes a shocking revelation to Hardik.

videos.title: Gautam, Dhara Get Intimate
videos.overview: Gautam and Dhara spend a romantic time in each other's company. While Dhara is excited about Dev's love life, Raavi's confession infuriates Prafulla.

videos.title: Raavi's Shocking Decision
videos.overview: Raavi takes a shocking decision after Prafulla expresses objection regarding her love for Dev. Later, Prafulla puts forth a grave accusation at Dev.

videos.title: Krish Upsets Dhara
videos.overview: Dhara gets upset at Krish when she notices him smoking a cigarette. Later, Shiva slaps Krish when the latter reacts rudely to Dhara's confrontation.

videos.title: Dhara's Unexpected Visitor
videos.overview: Shiva warns Prafulla to keep Raavi and Dev away. On the other hand, Dhara feels perplexed when Raavi's dad seeks her help.

videos.title: Can Jagat Convince Suman?
videos.overview: Raavi reveals to Shiva about her love for Dev. While Jagat tries to convince Suman about Raavi and Dev's marriage, Dhara expresses her emotions.

videos.title: Dev, Rishita's Romantic Moment
videos.overview: Suman puts forth a condition to Prafulla after recalling their rivalry from the past. Meanwhile, Dev and Rishita spend some quality time with each other.

videos.title: Dev is In a Tight Spot
videos.overview: While the wedding arrangements take place, Dev worries about Rishita. Later, he tries to talk with Gautam about his marriage.

videos.title: Shiva, Raavi's Funny Banter
videos.overview: Dhara faces a hard time when Shiva and Raavi get into a funny banter. Elsewhere, Gautam notices a shocking sight after meeting Janardhan.

videos.title: Dev to Reveal The Truth!
videos.overview: With the mounting pressure of the wedding, Dev decides to talk to Dhara about Rishita. On the other hand, Rishita is shocked on learning the truth.

videos.title: Dev's Haldi Ceremony
videos.overview: During the Haldi ceremony, Dev gets worried while Raavi is excited. Elsewhere, an emotional Rishita tries to commit suicide.

videos.title: Dev Confesses The Truth
videos.overview: While Raavi enjoys her Mehndi ceremony, Dev confesses his love for Rishita to Gautam and Dhara. Later, Jagat gives a stern warning to Gautam.

videos.title: Dhara to Stop The Marriage?
videos.overview: Janardhan's sister arrives at his house to try and convince Rishita to forget Dev. Elsewhere, Dhara decides to stop Dev and Raavi's wedding.

videos.title: Shiva and Raavi Lock Horns
videos.overview: Raavi comes to the house and offers to help out with the chores, unaware of Dev and Rishita's relationship. Later, due to a mishap, Shiva and Raavi lock horns!

videos.title: Gautam Spills The Beans
videos.overview: When Dhara decides to reveal the truth to Raavi, Gautam tells her about Dev. Later, Dhara lies to Suman about the situation.

videos.title: Dev’s Earnest Request
videos.overview: When Dhara tries to reason with Dev, he earnestly requests her to help him marry Rishita. Later, adhering to Dev’s request, Dhara goes to meet Janardhan.

videos.title: Dhara Gets Slapped
videos.overview: A helpless Dhara gets slapped mercilessly by Rishita's aunt. Later, Shiva and Dev create a scene at Janardhan's house in order to seek revenge.

videos.title: Dev Apologises to Dhara
videos.overview: Dev agrees to marry Raavi and apologises to Dhara. Later, the family shares a sentimental moment with Shiva.

videos.title: Shiva Consoles Dev
videos.overview: While Dev accepts the marriage with a hefty heart, Rishita goes to stop the ceremony. As Janardhan drags her away, Shiva consoles Dev for his sacrifice.

videos.title: Shiva's Brawl With Raavi
videos.overview: As everyone prepares for the wedding, Raavi tries to sneak in the house to catch a glimpse of Dev. Later, she bumps into Shiva and ends up in a brawl.

videos.title: Rishita Feels Insecure
videos.overview: Seeing Dev's wedding procession, Rishita feels very anxious. Later, Dev and Raavi tie the knot as the families shower their blessings.

videos.title: Rishita's Shocking Arrival
videos.overview: The wedding rituals of Raavi and Dev commence while Rishita's arrival leaves everyone baffled. Later, Dev confesses about his love for Rishita.

videos.title: Raavi Attempts Suicide
videos.overview: Raavi finds the truth about Dev and Rishita and loses her sanity. While everyone rebukes Dhara, Raavi goes to attempt suicide.

videos.title: Dhara Pleads With Shiva
videos.overview: To rectify her mistake, Dhara requests Shiva to marry Raavi and save her from her fate. Later, Shiva agrees, much to everyone's shock.

videos.title: Raavi, Shiva to Tie The Knot
videos.overview: Shiva prepares to marry Raavi while Rishita is excited about her marriage with Dev. The couples are showered with blessings as they enter holy matrimony.

videos.title: Rishita Takes a Stand
videos.overview: After Janardhan arrives at the wedding to create trouble, the Pandya brothers stand united against him. Later, Rishita protects all by threatening Janardhan.

videos.title: Rishita's Abominable Behaviour
videos.overview: As the marriage ceremony settles, Rishita behaves in an obnoxious manner and makes everyone uncomfortable. Later, her crude actions break Raavi's heart.

videos.title: Shiva Spews Venom
videos.overview: As Rishita insults Dhara during the Aarti ceremony, Shiva gets angry and spews venom at her. Later, Suman indirectly takes a stand for Dhara.

videos.title: Gautam Defends Dhara
videos.overview: Raavi accuses Shiva of marrying her intentionally and the duo argues. Later, as Suman accuses Dhara, Gautam takes a firm stand for her.

videos.title: Prafulla Starts Cribbing
videos.overview: Gautam defends Dhara in front of Suman. Later, Prafulla cribs about the presents gifted to Raavi as shagun.

videos.title: Raavi's Dreams are Shattered
videos.overview: As Rishita expresses her love for Dev, Raavi's dream of marrying him comes to an end. Later, Rishita creates a fuss about the size of her bedroom in the Pandya house.

videos.title: Dev Gets Defensive
videos.overview: Raavi loses her composure and requests Rishita to stop insulting her at every point. Later, Dev gets defensive when Rishita calls Raavi a baggage.

videos.title: Love Colours For Gautam, Dhara
videos.overview: Gautam apologises to Suman for his past behaviour. Dhara gives important advice to Shiva about life. Later, Gautam gets romantic with Dhara.

videos.title: Rishita's Mischevious Prank
videos.overview: Rishita smears lipstick on Dev's face to make others believe in their successful wedding night. Later, Dev shares a moment with her.

videos.title: Is Shiva Alright?
videos.overview: Dhara consoles an emotional Raavi while Janardhan's sister requests Rishita to come home. Elsewhere, Shiva falls unconscious while fighting some deadly goons.

videos.title: Shiva, Raavi Get Kidnapped
videos.overview: Shiva and Raavi are attacked and get kidnapped by a gang of goons. Later, Dev screams at Rishita for an insensitive comment about Shiva and Raavi.

videos.title: Shiva, Raavi In Trouble
videos.overview: Raavi and Shiva get kidnapped. While they face immense danger, Krish informs Dhara and the others about the abduction.

videos.title: Gautam Warns Janardhan
videos.overview: Gautam threatens Janardhan with legal action and demands that he return Shiva. Elsewhere, Suman, Dhara and Prafulla worry about the situation at hand.

videos.title: Raavi Misunderstands Shiva
videos.overview: Raavi is shocked when Shiva abandons her to fight the goons. While she misunderstands his intentions, a huge brawl breaks out.

videos.title: Gautam Threatens Janardhan
videos.overview: Gautam issues a stern warning to Janardhan for orchestrating the kidnapping. While Raavi conveys her hatred to Shiva, the family leaves to visit a Haveli.

videos.title: Dev, Shiva's Heated Spat
videos.overview: Dev and Shiva get into an intense argument during a fun game of Antakshari. Later, Gautam and Dhara advise them to mend their differences.

videos.title: Rishita Falls Sick
videos.overview: While Rishita suffers from food poisoning, Shiva questions Raavi for mistreating Dhara. Later, the Pandyas reach the haveli.

videos.title: Shiva, Raavi Share a Room
videos.overview: Dhara shows Raavi her new room and tells Shiva that he has to share it with her. While Shiva and Raavi come up with rules, Rishita likes their room.

videos.title: Dhara, Gautam Get Romantic
videos.overview: The family prepares for the Puja. Elsewhere, Dhara and Gautam get romantic with each other. Later, everyone attends the Kul Devta Puja.

videos.title: Rishita's Bad Behaviour!
videos.overview: Dhara requests Rishita to participate in the kitchen ceremony, but she decides to ignore it. Later, Rishita prepares food only for her and Dev, shocking everyone.

videos.title: Rishita Walks Out
videos.overview: Seeing Gautam feeding his brothers, Rishita feels disgusted and walks out, which upsets him. Later, Dev apologises for her behaviour.

videos.title: Gautam's Important Lesson
videos.overview: As the family sets up the bonfire, Shiva arrives in a new look and stuns all. Later, Gautam shares a valuable lesson about the family with the brides.

videos.title: Rishita is Frightened
videos.overview: Krish and Shiva distract everyone in order to carry their plan forward to scare Rishita. Later, Rishita is traumatized upon seeing a woman in white.

videos.title: Rishita Gets Horror-stricken!
videos.overview: Late in the night, Rishita beholds a woman in a white saree and gets frightened to death. Later, Raavi grows suspicious of Krish seeing make-up on his face.

videos.title: Dhara’s Mature Move
videos.overview: Dev apologises as Dhara makes Rishita understand their limits in public space. Later, Dhara tries to calm down Dev while he feels agitated by Rishita’s misconduct.

videos.title: Raavi's Emotional Outburst
videos.overview: A protective Shiva tries to find out what's bothering Raavi but she rebukes him harshly. When Dhara has a heart-to-heart conversation with her, she bursts into tears.

videos.title: Dev Apologises to Shiva
videos.overview: Dhara consoles an emotional Raavi while Dev apologises to Shiva. Elsewhere, Gautam warns Krish to focus on his studies and secure good marks.

videos.title: Gautam's Fatherly Act
videos.overview: A heartbroken Dhara tells Gautam about Raavi and Rishita's rift, and he decides to resolve the issue. Later, he explains to Rishita about her mistakes.

videos.title: Rishita Apologises to Raavi
videos.overview: While Gautam helps to resolve the issues between Raavi and Rishita, Raavi and Shiva continue their arguments. Later, Rishita apologises to Raavi.

videos.title: Krish Runs Away
videos.overview: Krish finds Raavi's cosmetics and runs away with them. On the other hand, Suman decides to teach Prafulla a lesson for ruining the peace in her house.

videos.title: Gautam Sides With Rishita
videos.overview: While Dev leaves for the market, Krish yells at Rishita for questioning Gautam. An enraged Gautam lashes out at him and justifies Rishita.

videos.title: Krish Feels Embarrassed
videos.overview: Flustered, Krish apologises to Rishita reluctantly. However, Rishita decides to go back to her parent's house as she feels Dev is not concerned about her.

videos.title: Rishita Falls Unconscious!
videos.overview: Krish groomed as a woman, dances and tries to scare Rishita. Startled, she falls unconscious on Krish's resemblance.

videos.title: Dhara Punishes Shiva, Krish
videos.overview: Dhara learns from Gautam about Shiva and Krish's cruel prank on Rishita and beats them. Later, she declares a harsher punishment for them.

videos.title: Dhara's Staunch Decision
videos.overview: When Gautam tries to reason with Dhara about her decision to divide the households, she refuses to change it. Later, Dhara breaks down for hurting the boys.

videos.title: Shiva Refuses to Change
videos.overview: Shiva and Krish try their best to win Dhara's heart but their efforts go in vain. Later, Shiva argues with Raavi and informs her that he won’t change.

videos.title: Shiva, Dev Get Punished
videos.overview: Shiva and Dev secretly share a meal with Gautam and Krish and get punished by Dhara. Later, Suman feels some tension in the family upon her arrival.

videos.title: Prafulla Gets On The Job
videos.overview: Prafulla instigates Rishita and tries to find out what Dhara and her boys are hiding from the family. While Gautam explains to Dhara about her decision, Suman has a hidden agenda.

videos.title: Anita Begins Conspiring
videos.overview: Suman baits Krish and finds out that the boys are hiding something from her. Elsewhere, Anita tells Prafulla of her evil plan to marry Gautam.

videos.title: Trouble Ahead For Dhara
videos.overview: Dhara lands in trouble when Suman forces her to tell the truth about the past incidents. Later, Prafulla tries to instigate Suman but in vain.

videos.title: Suman's Venomous Words
videos.overview: During the Shagun ceremony, Rishita creates a scene about the gifts. Agitated by her behaviour, Suman uses cold words to put Rishita in her place.

videos.title: Will Dhara Spill The Beans?
videos.overview: While Dhara's plan brings Raavi and Shiva together, Gautam makes her swear to tell Suman the truth. Later, Dhara has a nightmare.

videos.title: Shiva Behaves Rashly
videos.overview: Dhara's cold behaviour makes Shiva emotional and he burns his hand. While a shocked Raavi stops him, Gautam loses his cool at Dhara's heartless demeanour.

videos.title: Dhara is Worried
videos.overview: A nervous Dhara hallucinates about failing to unite the family and falls sick. While she tries to tell Suman the truth, Krish stops her.

videos.title: Raavi Takes a Stand
videos.overview: When Rishita mistakes Shiva’s shirt for a rag, a furious Raavi confronts her. Later, she supports Shiva when Rishita insults him.

videos.title: Shiva Opens Up to Raavi
videos.overview: When Raavi tells Shiva the reason behind supporting him, he confides in her about his past. Later, Dhara musters up the courage to tell Suman the truth.

videos.title: Rishita Fights With Dev
videos.overview: Raavi and Dhara have a fallout over the latter's actions towards the family. Elsewhere, a triggered Rishita fights Dev after he sides with Dhara.

videos.title: Rishita Tells The Truth
videos.overview: A triggered Rishita confronts Suman and tells the truth about Dhara. Shocked at the revelation, Suman fumes with anger.

videos.title: Suman Confronts Reality
videos.overview: Rishita unveils the truth about Dhara to Suman. Later, Suman witnesses the scars Dhara inflicted on Krish and consoles him.

videos.title: Suman Reprimands Dhara
videos.overview: Suman confronts Dhara for hiding the truth and lashes out at her. While Dhara stands frozen, Shiva leaves with Raavi to get the holy water from Mukteshwar.

videos.title: Shiva Protects Raavi
videos.overview: As the temple crumbles in Mukhteshwar, Shiva does his best to shield Raavi from harm. When she distrusts him, he emotionally expresses himself.

videos.title: Rishita to The Rescue
videos.overview: As Mukhteshwar crumbles, Rishita goes to rescue everyone. Meanwhile, a distraught Shiva tries his best to revive Raavi who starts giving up.

videos.title: Dhara Gets Banished
videos.overview: Suman punishes Dhara for breaking her family and asks her to leave. Later, she is shocked to learn how Rishita saved everyone's lives.

videos.title: Suman Stops Dhara
videos.overview: Gautam and the family plead with Suman to stop Dhara from leaving. Later, Dhara complies with Suman, and the Pandya family unites again.

videos.title: Shiva, Prafulla Lock Horns
videos.overview: While Dhara and Gautam get romantic, Dev and Rishita share a moment. The next morning, Shiva bumps into Prafulla and gets into an argument with her.

videos.title: Shiva's Change Of Heart?
videos.overview: Shiva finds himself getting attracted to Raavi. Later, Gautam gives a piece of big news to his brothers.

videos.title: Shiva Threatens Prafulla
videos.overview: After Suman exposes Prafulla before the family, Raavi asks her to leave. Later, a triggered Shiva threatens Prafulla with a sickle.

videos.title: Anita's Evil Move
videos.overview: An envious Anita plans a wicked move for Dhara to injure her. Elsewhere, Rishita spots Shiva partaking in suspicious activity.

videos.title: Will Dhara Fall In The Trap?
videos.overview: When Prafulla taunts Dhara, the latter gives a befitting response. Meanwhile, Raavi faces the consequences of Anita's devious plan instead of Dhara.

videos.title: Shiva Confronts Prafulla, Anita
videos.overview: Suman holds a family meeting to detect the culprit, and everyone shares their suspicions. Later, Shiva confronts Prafulla and Anita with evidence.

videos.title: Anita Frames Prafulla
videos.overview: When Anita frames Prafulla for the accident, Shiva says hurtful words that instigate Raavi. But what will Raavi do upon learning the truth?

videos.title: Rishita Gets Snooping
videos.overview: A distracted Shiva makes Rishita suspicious during the Pagfere ritual. Her doubts come true when she finds him at the money lender's office.

videos.title: Raavi and Shiva Bond
videos.overview: Away from Raavi, Shiva ends up texting her, and they share a friendly banter. Later, Raavi defends him against Rishita's accusations.

videos.title: Shiva's Shocking Condition
videos.overview: During the Pagphere Ki Rasam, Shiva demands Prafulla’s Kangan as Shagun, but she rejects it. Later, he gives a shocking ultimatum to her.

videos.title: Shiva's Explicit Condition
videos.overview: As Shiva puts forth a condition to Prafulla, a heartbroken Raavi makes a shocking declaration. Later, Dhara stops Rishita from revealing the truth.

videos.title: Raavi Gets a Surprise
videos.overview: Gautam asks for an explanation from Shiva for pawning the property. Later, Raavi is thrilled as she receives a surprise birthday party from the Pandyas.

videos.title: Shiva Achieves His Task
videos.overview: At the party, Shiva threatens Prafulla with suicide but she refuses to budge. When Raavi attempts to do the same, Prafulla gives away the kangan to Shiva.

videos.title: Shiva's Nobel Act
videos.overview: Shiva takes the Kangan from Prafulla but gets her a new set to make up for it. Later, everyone finds the reason behind Shiva mortgaging his land.

videos.title: Shiva is In a Happy Space
videos.overview: Shiva is elated to have Raavi back but refuses to show it. While things start normalising for the Pandyas, Janardhan plans a dirty move.

videos.title: Shiva Gets Into Trouble
videos.overview: Shiva gets caught with a large amount of money, and the police try to arrest him. But Raavi manages to help him escape while Dhara asks them to go underground.

videos.title: Shiva Grows Protective
videos.overview: Shiva gets protective about Raavi and they have a silly banter. Elsewhere, Gautam and Dev find out that Janardhan is behind framing Shiva.

videos.title: Shiva's Shocking Move
videos.overview: Shiva escapes from the clutches of the police and returns to Somnath with Raavi. Later, he goes to meet a lawyer and makes an unexpected request.

videos.title: Shiva Gets Abducted
videos.overview: To save the Pandya Stores, Shiva decides to confess to the police. Out of desperation, Dhara and Krish abduct him.

videos.title: Is This The End For Pandya Stores?
videos.overview: The police search for Shiva, but Dhara hides him safely. The Pandyas fight to protect their shop while the police come to close it with a warrant.

videos.title: Rishita to The Rescue?
videos.overview: As Shiva is about to be arrested, Rishita arrives with proof and saves him along with Pandya stores. Later, Shiva finds himself gravitating towards Raavi.

videos.title: A Celebration At The Pandyas'
videos.overview: Dev reveals to Shiva his idea of building a separate room for Dhara. Later, the Pandyas organise an event to celebrate the wedding reception of the newly-weds.

videos.title: Kamini, Kalyani Insult The Pandyas
videos.overview: Dev protests when Prafulla taunts Dhara for not becoming a mother. Later, Kamini and Kalyani bring expensive gifts at the reception, insulting the Pandyas.

videos.title: Rishita is Insulted
videos.overview: Dev does not allow Rishita to accept Kamini's gift and sends them away. Later, Kamini insults Rishita and uses hurtful words to demean her.

videos.title: Raavi Fights For Shiva
videos.overview: Raavi meets her old friend Sneha who insults Shiva before her. While Shiva misunderstands the situation, Raavi takes a stand for her husband.

videos.title: Shiva Gets Drunk
videos.overview: Shiva ends up drinking with Kaka and shares his woes with him. Later, a drunk Shiva looks at Raavi and wonders about her reason of choosing him.

videos.title: Shiva's Emotional Outburst
videos.overview: After reading Raavi's diary, Shiva gets emotional and misbehaves with her. Later, Raavi burns her diary and bids goodbye to her past.

videos.title: Dhara Feels Dejected
